    WELCOME TO THE CLUB

    How to listen.

    1. Pick a tape. Click any cassette in the 3D rack, or in The Collection row below it.
    2. Look closer (optional). Press Inspect tape and drag to turn it in your hands. Press Return to shelf or Esc when done.
    3. Insert it. Press Insert cassette and wait for the lid to close over the tape.
    4. Press Play. Use the play button in the control bar, or press Space. Press it again to pause.
    5. Control the music. Skip tracks with the outer arrows, hold back or forward with the double arrows, drag the bar to jump, and set VOL.
    6. Change tapes. Press Eject to return the tape to its slot, then pick another one.

    Add your own music

    • Language tabs (English, Tamil, Hindi, Malayalam, Telugu) keep a separate tracklist for each tape.
    • + Add song takes a YouTube link (steps below) or a direct link to an audio file.
    • Upload audio adds MP3, WAV, M4A and more from your device. Files stay in this browser and are never uploaded.
    • Record store: press Add to tape to drop a free genre sampler onto the selected tape.
    • Manage lets you reorder, edit, move or remove songs.

    Add a YouTube song

    1. Copy the link. On YouTube press Share → Copy link. Normal videos, youtu.be, Shorts and YouTube Music links all work.
    2. Choose where it goes. Select a tape, then the language tab you want, for example Tamil.
    3. Press + Add song. Leave Source on YouTube link and paste the link into Song link.
    4. Fill in the details. Press Get title & artist to fill them in automatically, or type them yourself.
    5. Press Add to playlist. The song appears in the tracklist with its thumbnail.
    6. Click the song to play it. The tape goes into the deck and the video plays below the controls. Play, pause, skip and volume work from the deck; rewind and forward jump 10 seconds.

    YouTube needs an internet connection. Some owners block embedding, and private, age-restricted or region-locked videos won't play. If a browser blocks autoplay, tap play inside the video once.

    Get around

    • Drag the room to look around and scroll or pinch to zoom. Room and Deck jump to preset views.
    • Space play / pause · ← → seek 5 seconds · Esc leave inspection.

    Share mix copies a link to the selected tape's tracklist so friends can add it to theirs. Uploaded files stay on your device and aren't included. Clearing browser data removes your saved playlists and uploads.
